177:t_1:89.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There are people cooperating with us, like Lieutenant $$マネキン$$ and him here.」

177:t_1:91.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I'm Major $$グラハム・エーカー$$. I'll be in your care once more.」

177:t_1:92.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's been a long time, Major $$グラハム$$.」

177:t_1:93.en:
$$さやか$$
「Could it be you still haven't had a proper talk with $$刹那$$?」

177:t_1:94.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I still can't forgive myself...」

177:t_1:95.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And then, in the assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$ in North America, we were beaten by the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$, and forced to fall back.」

177:t_1:96.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$バルビエル$$... So he got in our way on $$蒼の地球$$ too...」

177:t_1:97.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Without $$ゼロ$$ and the others backing us up then, we might have fallen to his poison too...」

177:t_1:98.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$カレン$$... Were you all fighting in $$新日本$$ the whole time?」

177:t_1:99.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ゼロ$$, $$スザク$$, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ and I joined the $$新日本$$ Volunteer Army along with the members of the former $$黒の騎士団$$.」

177:t_1:100.en:
$$クルツ$$
「As expected of $$新日本$$, the land of the Resistance. A volunteer army, that's really something.」

177:t_1:101.en:
$$デュオ$$
「And the $$プリベンター$$ and us, their collaborators, joined in too.」

177:t_1:102.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm relieved, $$五飛$$. Relieved that you were there too.」

177:t_1:103.en:
$$五飛$$
「I will never hesitate again. I intend to dedicate this life to the fight to restore peace.」

177:t_1:104.en:
$$カトル$$
「Besides us, the forces $$ゼロ$$ had gathered were assembled in $$新日本$$ too.」

177:t_1:105.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$竜馬$$... I never thought you'd be in $$新日本$$ too.」

177:t_1:106.en:
$$竜馬$$
「When I heard about crushing a huge force with a handful of people, I couldn't keep quiet.」

177:t_1:107.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But, $$竜馬$$, $$大貫$$ was worried about you suddenly quitting as the janitor at $$陣代高校$$.」

177:t_1:108.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You apologize to him for me. And tell him, 'Once things settle down, I'll be in your care again'...」

177:t_1:109.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「And then there are $$ロジャー・スミス$$ and $$キリコ・キュービィー$$.」

177:t_1:110.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I was fighting in $$新日本$$ during the $$再世戦争$$ as well, you see.」

177:t_1:111.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Since words do not reach these $$サイデリアル$$ fellows, it is against my wishes, but I had no choice but to accept $$ゼロ$$'s invitation.」

177:t_1:113.en:
$$宗介$$
「Looks like $$キリコ$$ is the same as ever.」

177:t_1:114.en:
$$カレン$$
「($$キリコ$$... You fought to protect $$新日本$$, the place of your memories with $$フィアナ$$, didn't you...)」

177:t_1:115.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But in the end... the $$黒の騎士団$$ was defeated and forced to flee from $$新日本$$.」

177:t_1:116.en:
$$スザク$$
「By the attack of that $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

177:t_1:118.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Like 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》, that man can control people's minds with the power of a $$スフィア$$...」

177:t_1:120.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「He amplifies the hatred in people's hearts.」

177:t_1:121.en:
$$ノイン$$
「That turned the citizens of $$新日本$$ into a mob... They were ruled by the hatred of $$ゼロ$$ they had locked away in their hearts...」

177:t_1:122.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And to stop them, I used the $$ギアス$$ I had sworn never to use again...」

177:t_1:124.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「No... If my failure to stop $$バルビエル$$ is the cause of it, I can't forgive myself...」

177:t_1:126.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I know. $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... The one who made me use $$ギアス$$ and plunged $$新日本$$ into the flames of war again...」

177:t_1:127.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I will repay that debt without fail.」

177:t_1:128.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What is the situation in $$新日本$$ now?」

177:t_1:129.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「General $$藤堂$$ and the members of the former $$黒の騎士団$$ are continuing to resist as guerrillas.」

177:t_1:130.en:
$$デュオ$$
「They're a gutsy bunch. No matter how overwhelming the $$サイデリアル$$ are, it'll take a lot of time to shut them up completely.」

177:t_1:131.en:
$$トロワ$$
「We left the fight in $$新日本$$ to them, then crossed to North America and joined up with $$カミーユ$$ and the others.」

177:t_1:132.en:
$$甲児$$
「So $$キラ$$ was in $$オーブ$$, and joined up with $$カミーユ$$ and the others there?」

177:t_1:133.en:
$$キラ$$
「Yeah... Until then, I'd been guarding $$オードリー$$ and Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$ together with Ensign $$リディ$$.」

177:t_1:134.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$オードリー$$ was in $$オーブ$$ too...!?」

177:t_1:135.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Yes... Ensign $$リディ$$'s family... the $$マーセナス家$$ arranged it.」

177:t_1:136.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Although $$オードリー$$ was about to be handed over to $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$ as a bargaining chip...」

177:t_1:137.en:
$$ボス$$
「$$アナハイム$$ is that giant corporation on the Moon, right? Why would they do that...」

177:t_1:138.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Their executive, $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$, is working to seal away $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

177:t_1:139.en:
$$バナージ$$
「To do that, she teamed up with the $$マーセナス家$$, who have the same goal.」

177:t_1:140.en:
$$宗介$$
「So we're talking about that thing again...」

177:t_1:141.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ said it's prayers offered up in the past that turned into a curse.」

177:t_1:143.en:
$$甲児$$
「Hold on a second...! Then does Ensign $$リディ$$ know what's inside the box!?」

177:t_1:148.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll take over and tell you what happened after $$オーブ$$.」

177:t_1:149.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ that appeared in $$オーブ$$ called on Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$, Vice Foreign Minister $$ナナリー$$, Princess $$マリナ$$ and Representative $$アスハ$$ there to surrender.」

177:t_1:150.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$カガリ$$ and the others accepted that demand so we could escape.」

177:t_1:152.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$オーブ$$ fell, and Representative $$アスハ$$ and the others were most likely captured by the Empire.」

177:t_1:153.en:
$$キラ$$
「And $$バナージ$$ and Ensign $$リディ$$ went up to space separately from us, to get $$ミネバ・ザビ$$ away.」

177:t_1:154.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There, $$バナージ$$ and the others were picked up by the $$ラー・カイラム$$ and Colonel $$シャア$$ and the others aboard.」

177:t_1:155.en:
$$甲児$$
「What had the Colonel been doing until then?」

177:t_1:156.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「He's been going around the colonies, gathering forces that oppose $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

177:t_1:157.en:
$$クェス$$
「I was helping with that too.」

177:t_1:158.en:
$$甲児$$
「Major $$コンロイ$$...! And $$クェス$$ too...!」

177:t_1:159.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Let me introduce the pilots attached to the $$ラー・カイラム$$ to you all.」

177:t_1:160.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「I'm Captain $$ナイジェル・ギャレット$$. I'm counting on you.」

177:t_1:161.en:
$$宗介$$
「Could you be from the $$トライスター$$...?」

177:t_1:162.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Looks like I'm known a little.」

177:t_1:163.en:
$$甲児$$
「What's this $$トライスター$$ you're talking about?」

177:t_1:164.en:
$$宗介$$
「They're the ace pilot unit of $$ロンド・ベル$$. I hear they're top-notch experts, famous among those in the know.」

177:t_1:165.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain $$ナイジェル$$... I had heard the $$トライスター$$, as the name says, was a three-man unit...」

177:t_1:166.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「My comrades $$ダリル$$ and $$ワッツ$$ are stuck on close escort duty for the $$ラー・カイラム$$. Only I go out to the front lines.」

177:t_1:167.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And then, aboard the $$ラー・カイラム$$, $$バナージ$$ and the others were attacked by $$マリーダ$$...」

177:t_1:168.en:
$$甲児$$
「Was that girl back with $$ネオ・ジオン$$?」

マネキン.evidence: Surname-only form of パトリック・マネキン (Patrick Mannequin, = コーラサワー/Colasour after marrying Kati; Kouji calls him コーラサワー中尉 in dlg_2026_00 row 83). No bare マネキン token in the sheet.

ミネバ・ザビ.evidence: Sheet has ミネバ・ラオ・ザビ (Mineva Lao Zabi); this shorter form appears in Kira's line.

アスハ.evidence: Surname in アスハ代表; カガリ・ユラ・アスハ = Cagalli Yula Athha in the sheet.
